name: Modmanager
tagline: This container needs special attention. Please check https://hub. Docker. Com/r/linuxserver/modmanager for details.
description: This container needs special attention. Please check https://hub.docker.com/r/linuxserver/modmanager for details.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/modmanager:version-7dc8618e@sha256:742583b32a779fbcbe7d0a8915bd4c6d4a9d7170e802cc576364b1cd3b971d1f
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
